body: Edit the release note before it goes out:
title: Release note
defaultValue:
Fixes a focus race where a character typed into the note pane could be read as the snooze shortcut and swallowed.

Also keeps an expired dialog on screen instead of closing it silently, so it is clear the agent moved on rather than that the dialog failed.

Known issue: a note pane opened over a form with long option descriptions can still overlap the footer.
